title: Golden Handcuffs
subtitle: Gold trafficking and the Amazon's shadow mining empire
synopsis: Gold does not rust, and it launders once. Episode 2 follows illicit gold from the mines of Colombia and the Brazilian Amazon to the refineries of Switzerland: the armed groups that now earn more from gold than from cocaine, the narcogarimpo economy of diesel and mercury, the refining chokepoint that buys in good faith, and the forensic effort to give a bar of gold a fingerprint. Thirty minutes. Three countries. Sam Rad on camera, David M. Luna as the institutional voice.
fullTitle: Illicit Gold: The Rush to Cash in on the Criminal Shadows of El Dorado
